top_signals.title: Oil Declines as Traders Parse Signs of Fresh Diplomacy on Iran
top_signals.summary: Oil dropped as traders weighed fresh diplomatic efforts in the Middle East to avert a potential restart of US military strikes on Iran.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Legal powerhouse Weil Gotshal to vote to liquidate after 95 years
top_signals.summary: US legal giant, Weil Gotshal and Manges’ partners are set to vote to liquidate the firm. This year, Weil has seen an exodus of heavy partners across the US as well as London, including former corporate co-managing partner Michael Hickey and private equity co-head Christopher Machera, who left the firm for US competitor Paul Weiss [...]
